ProtocolTarget.description:
Where the adapter sends its requests. Credentials are not part of the protocol: they are
in the adapter's environment (`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`,
`AWS_SESSION_TOKEN`, `AWS_REGION`), set from the target when it has them.

ca_cert_file.description: Extra PEM CA bundle to trust (a file path).

endpoint.description: Custom endpoint (S3-compatible services, the lab); absent: the provider's default.

insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (self-signed development endpoints).

path_style.description: Path-style addressing (`https://endpoint/bucket/key`) instead of virtual hosts.

scheme.description: OpenDAL scheme of the target (`s3` for every reference adapter).

description: oprobe client protocol (`--client exec:CMD`): the first line oprobe sends

concurrency_count.description: Operations oprobe keeps in flight at most (size the adapter's pool to it).

retries_count.description: Retries the client should make after a failed attempt (`knobs.retries`).

title: oprobe client-hello
